# VekUI WeApp

VekUI WeApp is a shadcn-style source registry for Taro React WeChat mini programs.

Important local docs:

- /weapp/quick-start/
- /weapp/cli/
- /weapp/components/
- /weapp/theme/
- /weapp/registry/
- /weapp/changelog/
- /weapp/ai-coding/

Agent rules:

- Do not use Radix, browser DOM APIs, ReactDOM, lucide-react, or third-party mini-program UI libraries inside VekUI components.
- Use semantic token classes and mini-program-safe Tailwind utilities.
- Treat packages/ui as canonical source and packages/registry as the public distribution contract.
